findings.title: Exact Result admission does not yet fail closed on stale package lifecycle state
findings.observation: Explore requires package/current Action identity equality and allows package state prepared|resumed, but does not require the package's captured lifecycle state to equal the exact current Action lifecycle state at admission.
findings.counterexample: ActionPackage captures prepared A. Current Action later becomes resumed A. Candidate Result still has the exact package runId, ActionIdentity, expected role/outcome slot, and null Verification verdict. All explicitly listed admission invariants pass even though the package is stale.
findings.impact: A late Result from the pre-resume package can be admitted after the current Action has advanced, weakening the claimed exact-package/current-Action boundary and making the next resume/terminal Change ambiguous.
findings.requiredRevision: Define a bounded freshness invariant: admission must reject package/current lifecycle-state mismatch (or an equivalent exact-current-package freshness rule), and add negative proof for prepared-package versus resumed-current state. Do not add PackageId/ResultId or generic replay infrastructure unless independently necessary.

proposalReadiness.statement: The Explore is bounded and nearly ready, but exact Result admission must explicitly bind package freshness to the exact current Action lifecycle state before Proposal.

limitations: This Review Explore verdict is neither Verification PASS nor Owner authority.
